summary: Canadian Natural Resources Limited filed a Form 6-K containing its press release for Q1 2026 results. The filing reports quarterly production of ~1,643,000 BOE/d, adjusted net earnings of $2.4B ($1.17/share), and adjusted funds flow of $4.4B ($2.10/share). It notes $1.5B returned to shareholders via dividends and buybacks. No M&A, activist, or restructuring event is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer.
